descriptor: Enhancing and maintaining the Crash Records Information System for TxDOT, ensuring compliance, performance, and user satisfaction.

requirements.statement: The system must provide ongoing technical support and maintenance services for CRIS.
The system must include a Help Desk Support module for users to report issues and receive assistance.
The system must continuously monitor CRIS to track system performance and reliability.
The system must integrate with TxDOT's existing IT infrastructure for real-time monitoring and support.
The system must provide regular performance reports and incident resolution logs.
The system must implement new features based on user feedback and operational needs.
The system must provide training sessions and materials for TxDOT staff on new functionalities.
The system must integrate user feedback collection mechanisms.
The system must generate required reports as specified by the TxDOT contract manager.
The system must ensure compliance with federal, state, and local laws.
The system must integrate with TxDOT’s financial systems for accurate reporting and compliance checks.
The system must handle the collection and management of responses to the solicitation.
The system must organize and store all required documentation for the response.
The system must evaluate and score responses based on TxDOT’s weighted scoring system.
The system must integrate with the Euna Procurement system for submission and tracking of responses.
The system must address potential risks associated with system performance and user error.
The system must include tools to identify and mitigate risks related to system outages or operator errors.
The system must integrate with incident management systems to log and track incidents.
The system must provide incident reports and risk assessment documentation.
Vendor employees must complete a TxDOT-approved cyber security training program.

stories.title: Implement Help Desk Support Module
stories.narrative: As a TxDOT user, I want to report issues and receive assistance, so that I can resolve problems quickly.
acceptance: Given a user has an issue, when they report it via the help desk, then they receive assistance.
Given a resolved issue, when the user checks the status, then it shows as resolved.
Trust: All help desk interactions are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Develop the Help Desk Support module, integrate with existing support tools.

stories.title: Establish System Monitoring Tools
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want continuous monitoring of CRIS, so that I can ensure system reliability.
acceptance: Given the system is running, when monitoring is active, then performance metrics are displayed.
Given a system outage, when it occurs, then an alert is generated.
Trust: All monitoring data is archived for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Set up monitoring tools, ensure integration with TxDOT IT infrastructure.

stories.title: Generate Performance Reports
stories.narrative: As a TxDOT manager, I want regular performance reports, so that I can assess system health.
acceptance: Given system data, when a report is generated, then it reflects current performance.
Given a report request, when data is missing, then an error is shown.
Trust: Reports are archived for future reference.
stories.task_guidance: Develop reporting templates, automate report generation.

stories.title: Implement Feature Development Module
stories.narrative: As a developer, I want to implement new features based on feedback, so that CRIS evolves with user needs.
acceptance: Given user feedback, when a feature is developed, then it meets user needs.
Given a feature request, when it is not feasible, then feedback is provided.
Trust: All feature changes are documented.
stories.task_guidance: Develop feature development module, integrate feedback mechanisms.

stories.title: Conduct User Training Sessions
stories.narrative: As a TxDOT staff member, I want training on new functionalities, so that I can use CRIS effectively.
acceptance: Given new features, when training is conducted, then staff understand functionalities.
Given a training session, when a user misses it, then a recording is available.
Trust: Training completion is logged.
stories.task_guidance: Organize training sessions, provide materials and recordings.

stories.title: Develop Reporting Engine
stories.narrative: As a TxDOT contract manager, I want to generate required reports, so that I meet reporting obligations.
acceptance: Given a report request, when generated, then it meets specifications.
Given a report error, when it occurs, then it is logged and addressed.
Trust: All reports are archived for compliance.
stories.task_guidance: Develop reporting engine, ensure integration with financial systems.

stories.title: Ensure Compliance with Laws
stories.narrative: As a compliance officer, I want to ensure system compliance with laws, so that TxDOT avoids legal issues.
acceptance: Given a compliance check, when conducted, then no violations are found.
Given a legal update, when it occurs, then the system is updated accordingly.
Trust: Compliance checks are logged.
stories.task_guidance: Implement compliance tracking tools, update system as laws change.

stories.title: Manage Response Submissions
stories.narrative: As a procurement officer, I want to manage response submissions, so that I can evaluate them efficiently.
acceptance: Given a response, when submitted, then it is stored correctly.
Given a submission error, when it occurs, then it is logged and addressed.
Trust: All submissions are tracked for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Develop submission management tools, integrate with Euna Procurement system.

stories.title: Evaluate and Score Responses
stories.narrative: As a procurement officer, I want to evaluate and score responses, so that I determine the best value offer.
acceptance: Given a response, when evaluated, then it is scored accurately.
Given a scoring error, when it occurs, then it is corrected.
Trust: All scores are archived for transparency.
stories.task_guidance: Develop evaluation metrics, ensure scoring system aligns with TxDOT standards.

stories.title: Implement Risk Assessment Tools
stories.narrative: As a risk manager, I want to identify and mitigate risks, so that CRIS operates smoothly.
acceptance: Given a risk assessment, when conducted, then risks are identified and mitigated.
Given a risk, when it is not mitigated, then it is logged for review.
Trust: All risk assessments are archived.
stories.task_guidance: Develop risk assessment tools, integrate with incident management systems.

stories.title: Ensure Cybersecurity Compliance
stories.narrative: As a security officer, I want to ensure cybersecurity compliance, so that TxDOT systems are secure.
acceptance: Given a cybersecurity training, when completed, then compliance is ensured.
Given a security breach, when it occurs, then it is logged and addressed.
Trust: All training completions are archived.
stories.task_guidance: Implement cybersecurity training program, ensure all employees complete it.

stories.title: Provide Ongoing Technical Support and Maintenance
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want to ensure ongoing technical support and maintenance services for CRIS, so that the system remains operational and efficient.
acceptance: Given the system is operational, when a technical issue arises, then the support team must resolve it within the SLA.
Given a maintenance schedule, when maintenance is due, then the system must undergo maintenance without disrupting services.
Trust: All support and maintenance activities must be logged and auditable.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a support ticketing system and schedule regular maintenance checks. Ensure all activities are logged in the support database.

stories.title: Organize and Store Required Documentation
stories.narrative: As a compliance officer, I want to organize and store all required documentation for the response, so that it is easily accessible and compliant with regulations.
acceptance: Given a new document, when it is uploaded, then it must be stored in the document management system.
Given a stored document, when it is accessed, then it must be retrievable within 2 seconds.
Trust: All document access and modifications must be logged.
stories.task_guidance: Use the document management system to categorize and store documents. Implement access controls and logging.

stories.title: Address Potential Risks Associated with System Performance and User Error
stories.narrative: As a risk manager, I want to address potential risks associated with system performance and user error, so that the system remains reliable and secure.
acceptance: Given system performance metrics, when anomalies are detected, then alerts must be generated for investigation.
Given user actions, when an error is made, then the system must provide corrective suggestions.
Trust: All anomalies and user errors must be logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement monitoring tools to detect performance anomalies and user error patterns. Log all incidents for review.

stories.title: Provide Incident Reports and Risk Assessment Documentation
stories.narrative: As a compliance officer, I want to provide incident reports and risk assessment documentation, so that stakeholders are informed of system risks and incidents.
acceptance: Given an incident, when it is reported, then a detailed report must be generated and stored.
Given a risk assessment, when it is completed, then the documentation must be accessible to authorized users.
Trust: All reports and assessments must be version-controlled and logged.
stories.task_guidance: Develop a reporting tool to generate incident reports and store risk assessments. Implement version control and access logging.
